description: The fork builds in Xcode and runs as its own app with its own name and bundle ID, separate from the official Boring Notch
steps: Open boringNotch.xcodeproj in Xcode
Build and run
See the notch app start
Check Activity Monitor shows the fork's own name
Check the app and XPC helper bundle IDs no longer start with theboringteam

description: The fork never checks for or installs upstream boring.notch updates
steps: Open the menu bar panel
See no 'Check for Updates' button
Run for 10 minutes with `lsof -i -a -p <pid>` and see no connection to TheBoredTeam.github.io

description: The notch shows the current song with artwork and controls it in Apple Music and Spotify
steps: Play a song in Apple Music
Hover the notch and see title, artist and artwork
Click pause, play, next and previous, and hear each work
Repeat with Spotify

description: The Shelf tab and the other notch features still work after the Mixer is added
steps: Open the notch
Click Shelf and drop a file on it
See the file on the shelf
Click Home and see music controls

description: The notch has a Mixer tab listing every app that uses sound, playing apps first with a green dot
steps: Play music
Open the notch
Click the Mixer tab next to Home and Shelf
See the music app at the top with a green dot
See other sound-using apps below it

description: Clicking the app's menu bar icon opens a panel with the same Mixer sliders plus Settings, Restart and Quit
steps: Click the menu bar icon
See the same apps and volumes as the Mixer tab
Change a volume in the panel and see the Mixer tab show it
Click Settings and see the settings window

description: The first volume change asks for System Audio Recording permission, and a denied permission shows a message saying where to enable it
steps: Remove the app from System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording
Drag an app below 100% in the Mixer
See the macOS permission prompt
Deny it and see the message in the Mixer
Allow it in System Settings and see the volume change work

description: Dragging one app's slider changes only that app's volume, right away
steps: Play music and a YouTube video in a browser
Drag the music app to 30%
Hear the music get quieter
Hear the browser stay the same

description: The speaker button mutes and unmutes one app
steps: Play music
Click the music app's speaker button
Hear silence from music only and see 'Muted'
Click it again and hear music back at its slider volume

description: Apps that play sound from helper processes (Discord, Chrome, Safari) show as one row and are controlled as one
steps: Open Discord, Chrome and Safari, each playing sound
Open the Mixer
See exactly one row each for Discord, Chrome and Safari
Lower each one and hear its sound change

description: A game, a call app, a music app and Discord play at four different volumes at the same time
steps: Run a game, a call, music, and Discord notifications
Set them to 80%, 100%, 20% and 40%
Hear each at its set level for 5 minutes

description: Turned-down apps have no pops, crackles, delay or stutter during long use
steps: Set a game or call app to 60%
Play or talk for 30 minutes
Hear no pops, crackles or stutter, and no noticeable delay against the video

description: Apps at 100% are never tapped and play exactly as without the Mixer
steps: Set one app to 50% and leave another at 100%
Confirm only one tap exists, for the 50% app
Drag it back to 100% and confirm its tap is removed

description: Each app's volume and mute come back after the app restarts, the notch app restarts, and the Mac reboots
steps: Set Discord to 30% and mute Music
Quit and reopen Discord and hear it at 30%
Restart the notch app and see the same settings
Reboot and hear Discord at 30% and Music muted

description: Volumes stay correct when switching between speakers, wired headphones and AirPods while audio plays
steps: Play music at 30% on speakers
Connect AirPods and hear 30%
Plug in wired headphones and hear 30%
Unplug and hear 30% on speakers

description: Quitting or force-killing the notch app leaves no app silent
steps: Set music to 20% and mute Discord
Click Quit and hear both at normal volume
Reopen the app and run `kill -9` on it
Hear both at normal volume

description: The Mixer adds no network code and writes no audio to disk
steps: Search the Mixer files for URLSession, Network and file writes, and find none
Run with two apps turned down for 10 minutes and see no new files with audio in the app's container
